content.label: Mist into The girl in the bamboo
Into A woman of shining beauty
Mist into The moon people come
Mist into Home to the moon

cues.text: Long ago, an old bamboo cutter went into the grove,
and found a stalk that shone like the moon.
Inside, no bigger than his thumb, sat a tiny girl.
He carried her home, and they named her Kaguya.
In three months she grew into a woman of shining beauty.
Her light filled the whole house.
Five great lords came to ask for her hand.
She asked each for a treasure no one could find:
a jewelled branch, a fire-rat robe, a dragon's pearl…
None of them could bring it.
Then, night after night, she wept at the moon.
'I came from the Moon,' she said at last,
'and they are coming to take me home.'
The Emperor sent two thousand soldiers to guard her.
But in a blaze of light the moon people came,
and not one arrow would fly.
An envoy wrapped her in a robe of feathers,
and all her earthly sorrow was forgotten.
She rose to the moon, and was gone.
The Emperor burned her last letter
on the highest mountain,
and they say its smoke still rises to the moon.
